name: aor-kb
description: Preview 0.x: evidence-graded knowledge-base skills for agents. Two skills: aor-kb-query, which searches a knowledge base and returns only claims that clear a trust grade, each stamped with its label; and aor-kb-capture, which records what a session learned as a graded claim behind a fail-closed employer-boundary guard. Windows only; needs Python 3.9 or later on PATH as python, plus the pinned strictyaml in requirements.txt.
